pages.text: A $(item)Bus Stop Sign$() or a $(item)Bus Shelter$() makes a stop. Its owner right-clicks it to name it and put it on up to three $(l)routes$(), with its stop number on each.
Right-click a stop to wait there, or sit on a shelter's bench.

Give a bus a route where its fare is set. Stopped at a stop, its driver presses $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to open the doors: whoever rang gets off and whoever's waiting gets on. Passengers press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to ring for the next stop. Villagers ride too, and pay.
Everyone aboard is told each stop, and the next one.
